visual_review.note: Live pages were inspected where accessible. Screenshots are not redistributed because this is a visual-reference study. Blocked or unstable pages are marked in notes.

license_policy.CODE_REUSE_ALLOWED: Only where an explicit license was verified; no code was copied in this task.
license_policy.VISUAL_REFERENCE_ONLY: Architecture may inform an independent Vitrina design; implementation and assets must not be copied.
license_policy.LICENSE_UNVERIFIED: Do not reuse code or assets until the exact license is verified.

directions.name: Chromatic Fullscreen Chapters
directions.license_note: Framer Community content is licensed per project and may not be redistributed as a competing template.
directions.architecture: A sequence of full-viewport color chapters with one idea and one action per screen.
directions.navigation: Compact menu plus chapter progression.
directions.slider_motion: Vertical fullscreen chapter transitions; motion can reduce to ordinary stacked sections.
directions.mobile_behavior: Validated at 390px: single-column chapters, centered CTA, no horizontal overflow.
directions.similarity: Both use a concentrated viewport and minimal controls.
directions.material_difference: This is a multi-chapter narrative system rather than one fixed hero.
directions.independent_concept: Color-coded service chapters with persistent progress and reduced-motion fallback.
directions.must_not_copy: Framer structure, wording, palette, avatar, illustrations, transitions or assets.

directions.name: Horizontal Filmstrip
directions.license_note: Clone availability is not a redistribution license for a Vitrina template product.
directions.architecture: Projects or services form a horizontal cinematic reel; detail views preserve the visual language.
directions.navigation: Wheel, trackpad or swipe advances a horizontal filmstrip.
directions.slider_motion: Horizontal page architecture with parallax layers and seamless detail transitions.
directions.mobile_behavior: Validated at 390px without overflow; should become touch-swipe cards with visible progress.
directions.similarity: Both present a portfolio as a continuous visual sequence.
directions.material_difference: The entire information architecture is horizontal, not a vertical page with a horizontal gallery.
directions.independent_concept: A finite horizontal work reel with explicit arrows, position counter and vertical mobile fallback.
directions.must_not_copy: Webflow implementation, film titles, typography, imagery, transitions or cloneable project.

directions.name: Draggable Property Atlas
directions.license_note: The live commercial site and its assets are proprietary.
directions.architecture: Fullscreen destination story connected to an interactive selector or catalog.
directions.navigation: Menu plus drag/swipe selector and direct register/contact action.
directions.slider_motion: Draggable parallax catalog; motion exposes inventory rather than decorating it.
directions.mobile_behavior: Validated at 390px: coherent hero and controls; selector needs large touch targets and list fallback.
directions.similarity: Both rely on immersive photography and large type.
directions.material_difference: The selector is a data-backed product surface, not simply a visual section.
directions.independent_concept: Inventory-aware visual selector linked to availability and lead capture.
directions.must_not_copy: Brand, property data, maps, photographs, serif treatment or interaction details.

directions.name: Vertical Snap Story
directions.license_note: Codrops states downloadable demos are MIT unless specifically noted otherwise; verify the individual download notice again before any reuse.
directions.architecture: One full-screen story frame at a time with fixed title rail and progress.
directions.navigation: Scroll, drag, keyboard and explicit chapter labels.
directions.slider_motion: Vertical snap slides with foreground/background displacement.
directions.mobile_behavior: Validated at 390px without overflow; content remains legible but controls need stronger contrast and tap affordance.
directions.similarity: Both use full-bleed imagery and dramatic typography.
directions.material_difference: Discrete snap states replace the conventional scrolling document.
directions.independent_concept: Accessible vertical slide narrative with normal-document fallback.
directions.must_not_copy: Demo images, text, exact typography, transition timing or source unless separately reviewed under MIT.

directions.name: Grid-to-Fullscreen Catalog
directions.license_note: Codrops demos default to MIT unless an individual demo states otherwise; provenance must be retained if code is later evaluated.
directions.architecture: Dense visual index expands an item into a focused full-screen story and returns to the same position.
directions.navigation: Grid browsing followed by direct item expansion.
directions.slider_motion: Shared-element grid-to-detail transition; not a conventional carousel.
directions.mobile_behavior: Use two-column or single-column index and disable expensive transforms under reduced motion.
directions.similarity: Both begin with a dense visual catalog.
directions.material_difference: The animated expansion creates spatial continuity and detail navigation.
directions.independent_concept: Reusable grid-to-detail transition primitive for projects, menu items and treatments.
directions.must_not_copy: Demo artwork, layout values or transition code without a final per-artifact license check.

directions.name: Live Type Specimen
directions.license_note: Proprietary site and typefaces.
directions.architecture: The headline behaves as a living specimen; service proof and CTA orbit the type rather than cards.
directions.navigation: Small utility controls around a dominant interactive canvas.
directions.slider_motion: Animated phrase/type state; motion is content.
directions.mobile_behavior: Large type must recompose into controlled lines; interaction becomes tap-based and optional.
directions.similarity: Both place typography ahead of photography.
directions.material_difference: The type is interactive and continuously demonstrates brand character instead of decorating a gallery.
directions.independent_concept: Greek kinetic headline generator using local fonts and business proof tokens.
directions.must_not_copy: Typeface files, phrases, mustard/black identity, menu capsule or animation choreography.

directions.name: Archive Index
directions.license_note: Proprietary editorial site and archive content.
directions.architecture: A compact directory is the homepage; chronology, categories and status replace hero imagery.
directions.navigation: Alphabetical/chronological index with filters and preview state.
directions.slider_motion: Little required motion; hover or tap preview is enough.
directions.mobile_behavior: Collapse columns into a filterable ordered list; preserve fast scanning and sticky filters.
directions.similarity: Both favor navigation and index-like information density.
directions.material_difference: The index itself is the visual identity and primary interaction, not a sidebar beside content sections.
directions.independent_concept: Searchable service/case index with status, year and category columns.
directions.must_not_copy: Archive entries, type treatment, strike-through behavior or studio identity.

directions.name: Newsstand Mosaic
directions.license_note: Proprietary publication design and content.
directions.architecture: A newsroom grid mixes lead stories, small updates, products and category rails at multiple scales.
directions.navigation: Topic navigation, search and dense chronological feed.
directions.slider_motion: Ticker and horizontal category rails are optional components.
directions.mobile_behavior: Lead story first, then a single feed with compact metadata; commerce remains secondary.
directions.similarity: Both use editorial hierarchy and mixed content density.
directions.material_difference: A real newsstand blends continuously updated content, shop modules and multi-speed reading.
directions.independent_concept: Reject as a new theme; extract stronger editorial feed and category rail primitives into magazine.
directions.must_not_copy: Publication content, product art, type system or page composition.

directions.name: Editorial Commerce Counter
directions.license_note: Proprietary brand, photography and implementation.
directions.architecture: Oversized editorial message shares the viewport with one tactile product image and immediate catalog rail.
directions.navigation: Full commerce navigation remains visible; each band ends with a direct next action.
directions.slider_motion: Product rails can swipe horizontally, but the typography/image tension defines the theme.
directions.mobile_behavior: Headline, image and catalog become stacked; buy/order action stays sticky or repeated.
directions.similarity: Both use editorial food branding and strong product photography.
directions.material_difference: This combines an active shop/navigation system with magazine-scale typography.
directions.independent_concept: Editorial storefront with a persistent order rail and modular seasonal message.
directions.must_not_copy: Brand red, logo, packaging, product imagery, copy or exact navigation.

directions.name: Spatial Material Catalog
directions.license_note: Proprietary commercial site; live visual loader was slow during review.
directions.architecture: Projects occupy a controlled stage with numbered states, sparse annotations and material-led navigation.
directions.navigation: Numbered collection states and minimal overlay menu.
directions.slider_motion: Project/story slider with architectural pacing.
directions.mobile_behavior: Transform stage into vertical project cards with preserved numbering and clear swipe cue.
directions.similarity: Both treat work as authored portfolio pieces.
directions.material_difference: The numbered material catalog creates a quiet product selector rather than an art portfolio.
directions.independent_concept: Numbered material/project stage with specs and inquiry attached to each item.
directions.must_not_copy: Project photography, branded loader, menu labels, transitions or visual identity.

directions.name: Modular Product OS
directions.license_note: Proprietary brand and site; the live page returned an empty document in the automated inspection, so this direction relies on public visual evidence and requires re-review.
directions.architecture: Strict modules combine product facts, glyphs, specs, offers and actions as a coherent operating-system-like surface.
directions.navigation: Utility-first global navigation and product-specific modules.
directions.slider_motion: Horizontal product rails and small state transitions, not a hero carousel.
directions.mobile_behavior: Modules reflow to one column; data order must remain meaningful without visual placement.
directions.similarity: Both use mixed-size modules.
directions.material_difference: A tokenized information system joins specs, commerce and product states instead of decorative cards.
directions.independent_concept: Reject as a separate theme; evolve bento with semantic module types and strict content contracts.
directions.must_not_copy: Dot-matrix branding, glyphs, product renders, palette, copy or module dimensions.

directions.name: Care Pathway
directions.license_note: Proprietary commercial product and content.
directions.architecture: An empathetic outcome-led hero feeds a structured pathway: choose audience, find location, understand service, start.
directions.navigation: Audience and location tasks outrank generic page links.
directions.slider_motion: Minimal; confidence comes from progressive disclosure and pathway modules.
directions.mobile_behavior: Large readable promise, one primary action and compact location/service choice.
directions.similarity: Both organize medical services around patient needs.
directions.material_difference: The complete journey includes membership/location pathways and repeated task resolution, not only triage content.
directions.independent_concept: Reject as a new theme; strengthen clinic-triage with audience/location pathways and outcome-led proof.
directions.must_not_copy: Amazon/One Medical branding, photography, membership claims, copy or curved image motif.

directions.name: Booking Ritual
directions.license_note: Proprietary business site, photography and content.
directions.architecture: Treatment discovery, booking and gift purchase are parallel primary journeys from the first viewport.
directions.navigation: Booking, pricing, categories, locations and gifts are first-class.
directions.slider_motion: Hero imagery may rotate, but treatment taxonomy and booking state are the core.
directions.mobile_behavior: Sticky booking action, thumb-friendly treatment categories and location-first flow.
directions.similarity: Both target beauty/wellness with soft editorial presentation.
directions.material_difference: This is a transaction-ready service catalog with booking, gifts and locations.
directions.independent_concept: A booking contract that every beauty theme can render, with service duration, price, staff and location.
directions.must_not_copy: Logo, beige identity, treatment photographs, Greek copy, icons or booking UI.

directions.name: Service-Area Finder
directions.license_note: Proprietary commercial site and brand assets.
directions.architecture: Emergency promise is immediately followed by service selection, postcode/area check and availability action.
directions.navigation: Trade, pricing and location tasks dominate; account and booking are persistent.
directions.slider_motion: No necessary slider; availability interaction is the differentiator.
directions.mobile_behavior: Service and location inputs stack before secondary content; call/booking remains persistent.
directions.similarity: Both prioritize urgent contact and technician services.
directions.material_difference: Live service-area/availability qualification converts the page into a lead-routing tool.
directions.independent_concept: Area eligibility and urgency form as a reusable product capability across technician themes.
directions.must_not_copy: Brand, van imagery, pricing, postcode UI appearance, copy or information hierarchy verbatim.

directions.name: Scientific Immersion
directions.license_note: Proprietary brand, scientific media and implementation.
directions.architecture: A moving scientific canvas carries a concise promise; evidence appears as restrained chapters.
directions.navigation: Floating capsule navigation with one strong contact action.
directions.slider_motion: Ambient video/visual field and scroll-led evidence reveals.
directions.mobile_behavior: Replace heavy video with optimized still or short loop; preserve the evidence sequence and contact action.
directions.similarity: Both use motion and atmosphere to create premium presence.
directions.material_difference: Scientific evidence and product explanation are integrated into the immersive canvas.
directions.independent_concept: Evidence-led immersive hero with low-bandwidth still fallback and measured reveal system.
directions.must_not_copy: Medical claims, neural imagery, brand mark, navigation capsule or motion footage.

directions.name: Treatment Menu Editorial
directions.license_note: Proprietary business site and assets.
directions.architecture: Editorial beauty story alternates strong type, restrained imagery, service menus and appointment prompts.
directions.navigation: Treatments, story and booking are clear without exposing the whole catalog at once.
directions.slider_motion: Subtle image/service carousel may support the story but is not mandatory.
directions.mobile_behavior: Typography and treatment lists lead; imagery becomes secondary and booking remains close.
directions.similarity: Both use editorial typography and premium beauty cues.
directions.material_difference: The service menu and appointment rhythm are the structural spine rather than a portfolio showcase.
directions.independent_concept: Reject as a new theme; feed its service-menu rhythm and booking cadence into beauty-atelier.
directions.must_not_copy: Brand identity, service names, photography, editorial art direction or copy.

directions.name: Price-Led Service Board
directions.license_note: Proprietary business site and content.
directions.architecture: A scan-friendly service and price system precedes storytelling; users decide quickly and book.
directions.navigation: Anchored service categories, pricing and appointment action.
directions.slider_motion: Optional review or work carousel; pricing remains static and accessible.
directions.mobile_behavior: Accordion or sticky category index keeps long price lists usable at 390px.
directions.similarity: Same beauty vertical and premium service presentation.
directions.material_difference: Pricing is the hero and principal navigation, creating a different buying behavior.
directions.independent_concept: Price-first theme driven by a structured service/duration/price data contract.
directions.must_not_copy: Prices, service copy, branding, photography or menu styling.

directions.name: Quiet Destination Journal
directions.license_note: Proprietary luxury brand, photography and booking experience.
directions.architecture: Large breathing space, destination-led chapters, quiet service detail and a persistent reservation path.
directions.navigation: Destinations and experiences lead; booking remains globally available.
directions.slider_motion: Slow editorial gallery and destination transitions rather than autoplay marketing carousel.
directions.mobile_behavior: One destination story per screen; booking/date controls must remain compact and obvious.
directions.similarity: Both use calm hospitality imagery and generous spacing.
directions.material_difference: A destination and reservation system organizes the entire experience.
directions.independent_concept: Quiet hospitality journal with availability CTA and destination chapters.
directions.must_not_copy: Aman name, imagery, editorial copy, booking UI or exact luxury art direction.

directions.name: Split-Screen Service Carousel
directions.license_note: Codrops downloadable demos default to MIT unless stated otherwise; the individual archive must be rechecked before reuse.
directions.architecture: A stable service summary and CTA share the viewport with a changing image/detail panel.
directions.navigation: Explicit previous/next, labels and dots; no hidden drag-only behavior.
directions.slider_motion: Split-screen service or project slider with independent text and media transitions.
directions.mobile_behavior: Stack text above media, retain labeled controls and allow swipe; never hide the CTA in a slide.
directions.similarity: Both divide text and image into parallel halves.
directions.material_difference: One half is a navigable service/story sequence rather than a static hero.
directions.independent_concept: Accessible labeled split-carousel driven by service data.
directions.must_not_copy: Demo images, text, CSS or interaction implementation without final license/provenance review.

directions.name: Living Information Canvas
directions.license_note: Proprietary site and studio work.
directions.architecture: Information, marks and project fragments coexist on a responsive canvas rather than in rectangular sections.
directions.navigation: Floating labels and spatial grouping guide exploration.
directions.slider_motion: Cursor/scroll movement reveals relationships; motion must become simple reveal/order on touch.
directions.mobile_behavior: Convert free canvas into a deliberate sequence with the same typographic energy and no overlaps.
directions.similarity: Both use motion and expressive typography.
directions.material_difference: Spatial information relationships, not clipped text reveals, define the layout.
directions.independent_concept: Constraint-based spatial canvas with a deterministic mobile reading order.
directions.must_not_copy: Studio work, cursor behavior, graphic fragments, copy or exact spatial arrangement.

collection_verdict.reason: The set changes navigation model, information architecture, interaction and buying journey—not merely color and typography. It includes horizontal, snap, directory, price-first, booking-first, service-finder, editorial commerce, kinetic type and spatial-canvas systems.
